faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about Ticket Rush

booking.q: How do I book a ticket?
booking.a: Find an event → Click "Book" → Choose your seat on the interactive map → Pay → Get your QR code. The whole process takes just 2-3 minutes.

booking.q: Can I choose a specific seat?
booking.a: Yes! Ticket Rush provides an interactive seat map so you can view and pick individual seats. Your seat is held for 10 minutes to complete payment.

booking.q: Is there a ticket limit per person?
booking.a: Yes, each event allows a maximum of 2-6 tickets depending on the organizer's rules. The limit is clearly shown on the event page.
When an event has high traffic, the system automatically activates a virtual queue to ensure fairness. You will receive a queue position and a notification when it's your turn.

payment.a: Ticket Rush supports VNPay (ATM/Internet Banking), MoMo, and simulated payment (demo). All transactions are SSL-encrypted.

payment.q: Can I cancel and get a refund?
payment.a: You can cancel within 10 minutes while the order is awaiting payment. After confirmation, refund policy depends on each specific event.
Enter the code at checkout. The discount is applied automatically. Each code may have usage limits and an expiry date.

ticketCheckin.q: How do I receive my ticket?
ticketCheckin.a: After successful payment, the QR code appears immediately under "My Tickets". You can also download a PDF to print.
QR codes are signed with JWT and a secret key, verifiable for authenticity. Each ticket is single-use — once scanned it cannot be used again.

ticketCheckin.q: What if I lose my phone?
ticketCheckin.a: Sign back in on any device, go to "My Tickets" to view your QR again. It's also a good idea to download the PDF as a backup.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By using Ticket Rush, you agree to comply with all of these terms. If you disagree, please do not use the service.

sections.title: 2. User Accounts
sections.content: You are responsible for securing your account information. Account sharing or ticket fraud is not permitted. Each account has a maximum ticket limit per event as set by the organizer.

sections.title: 3. Booking and Payment
sections.content: Seats are held for 10 minutes after selection. If payment is not completed within this time, the seat will be released. All payments via VNPay/MoMo are secured by SSL/TLS.

sections.title: 4. Refund Policy
sections.content: Refunds are only issued when an event is cancelled by the organizer, or according to the event-specific policy announced in advance. Ticket Rush is not responsible for organizer cancellation decisions.

sections.title: 5. Ticket Use
sections.content: QR codes are single-use and non-transferable unless permitted. Fake or altered tickets will not be accepted. Ticket Rush is not responsible for tickets purchased from third parties.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content, design, and features of Ticket Rush are our property. Copying, distributing, or commercial use without written permission is prohibited.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Ticket Rush provides a technical platform connecting users with event organizers. We are not responsible for the quality, content, or any issues arising from the event itself.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Ticket Rush is committed to protecting your personal information. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your data when using our service.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect: (1) Registration info — name, email, phone number; (2) Booking info — transaction history, selected seats; (3) Technical info — IP address, browser type, access time to improve the service.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used to: process bookings and payments, send confirmation emails and event reminders, improve user experience, detect fraud and protect accounts.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: Passwords are hashed with Argon2id — the most secure algorithm available. Data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS. No credit card information is stored — payments are processed directly via VNPay/MoMo.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do NOT sell your personal information. Information is only shared with: event organizers (to confirm tickets), payment partners (VNPay, MoMo), and law enforcement when legally required.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to maintain login sessions, remember language preferences, and improve performance. You can disable cookies in browser settings, but some features may not work.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to: access and export personal data, correct inaccurate information, request account and data deletion, unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time.

booking.q: How many tickets can I book?
booking.a: Each event has its own limit (usually 4-6 per person), shown on the event page.
You can request cancellation in My Tickets. Admin will process the refund within 3-5 days.

payment.a: Currently VNPay, MoMo, and simulated payment (demo).
All transactions are encrypted and processed through official VNPay/MoMo gateways.

payment.q: I was charged but didn't receive my ticket?
payment.a: Please wait 5-10 minutes. If still missing, contact support with your transaction ID.

ticketCheckin.q: How do I use my QR ticket?
ticketCheckin.a: Open My Tickets, select the ticket, and show the QR code to staff at the venue entrance.
Tickets are valid until the event date. After the event, they automatically expire.

ticketCheckin.q: Can I download tickets as PDF?
ticketCheckin.a: Yes, click the Download PDF button in the ticket details to save offline.
